'''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars''''' was a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The [[The Clone Wars 1|first issue]] was released on [[September 10]], [[2008]]. The series ran for 12 issues tied in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series. The first story arc was written by [[Henry Gilroy]], the head writer for the first season of the show. The series was supposed to be composed of only six issues, but it was so successful that on January 18, 2009, Dark Horse editor [[Randy Stradley]] announced six more issues. Those issues were composed of two three-part stories, co-written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and series writer [[Steven Melching]]. All Issues were later compiled in three separate trade paperbacks and released in the same format as the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (graphic novellas)|Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] ''graphic novellas. On [[December 28]], [[2009]], Randy Stradley announced the cancellation of the series due to the young-comics-readers market being too small.<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=16681|thread=The Clone Wars}}</ref>
